title: Polizei Berlin erlässt Allgemeinverfügung zum 2. August 2026

extraction.placeName: Denkmal für die im Nationalsozialismus ermordeten Sinti und Roma Europas
extraction.summaryEn: Police issued a general order banning public assemblies and events in the government district around the Sinti and Roma memorial in Berlin-Mitte on 2 August 2026, the international day of remembrance. The restriction runs from 6:00 to 23:59 to protect commemorations and quiet remembrance.
